top_signals.title: Stocks Waver, Treasuries Dip Ahead of Nvidia Earnings, PCE Data | Bloomberg Brief 08/26/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver and Treasuries fall ahead of quarterly results from Nvidia and July's PCE data, the Federal Reserve’s preferred inflation gauge. The Trump administration mulls additional trade measures against Canada after Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiled dollar-for-dollar retaliation to new tariffs imposed by the US. Matt Maley of Miller Tabak looks ahead to the inflation data and earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Fall as Iran-Oman Talks Fuel Hopes of Strait Reopening
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices dipped earlier today following news reports about Iran and Oman renewing their talks about joint management of the Strait of Hormuz, as those reports were taken to mean the waterway could soon reopen for normal traffic. Reuters reported that the two were discussing “a joint temporary navigational corridor” and clearing the strait of mines. top_signals.summary: Improving economic conditions are driving renewed activity in Africa's capital markets according to Yvonne Ike at Bank of America. She spoke to Chief Africa correspondent Jennifer Zabasajja on Bloomberg's Next Africa program. (Source: Bloomberg)
